ingredients: rice:2 cup, tomato:2, onion:1, oil:2 tbsp, salt:1 tsp, cumin seeds:1 tsp
steps: 1. Heat oil, add cumin seeds. 2. Saute chopped onion until golden. 3. Add chopped tomato, cook until soft. 4. Add cooked rice and salt, mix well. 5. Serve hot.
tips: Use leftover rice for a quicker version. Add peas or carrots for extra nutrition.

ingredients: rice:1 cup, lentils:1 cup, carrot:1, peas:0.5 cup, onion:1, ghee:2 tbsp, turmeric:0.5 tsp, salt:1 tsp
steps: 1. Wash rice and lentils together. 2. Pressure cook with chopped vegetables, turmeric, and salt. 3. Add ghee on top before serving.
tips: A comforting one-pot meal, easy to digest. Substitute ghee with oil for a vegan version.

ingredients: pasta:200 g, garlic:4 clove, olive oil:3 tbsp, chili flakes:1 tsp, salt:1 tsp, parsley:2 tbsp
steps: 1. Boil pasta until al dente. 2. Heat olive oil, saute sliced garlic until golden. 3. Add chili flakes and drained pasta, toss well. 4. Garnish with parsley.
tips: Save a little pasta water to loosen the sauce if it looks dry.

ingredients: egg:4, onion:1, tomato:1, green chili:1, oil:2 tbsp, salt:1 tsp, turmeric:0.25 tsp
steps: 1. Heat oil, saute onion, chili and tomato. 2. Add turmeric and salt. 3. Crack eggs in, scramble until cooked. 4. Serve with bread or rice.
tips: Add grated paneer for a richer version.

ingredients: chickpeas:2 cup, cucumber:1, tomato:1, onion:0.5, lemon:1, olive oil:2 tbsp, salt:1 tsp
steps: 1. Drain and rinse chickpeas. 2. Chop cucumber, tomato, and onion. 3. Mix all with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
tips: Best served chilled; keeps well in the fridge for 2 days.

ingredients: wheat flour:2 cup, potato:2, onion:0.5, green chili:1, oil:3 tbsp, salt:1 tsp
steps: 1. Boil and mash potato, mix with onion, chili, salt. 2. Stuff mixture into wheat dough, roll flat. 3. Cook on tawa with oil until golden on both sides.
tips: Serve hot with curd or pickle.

ingredients: rice:2 cup, carrot:1, beans:0.5 cup, capsicum:1, soy sauce:2 tbsp, oil:2 tbsp, garlic:3 clove
steps: 1. Heat oil, saute garlic and chopped vegetables. 2. Add cooked rice and soy sauce. 3. Stir-fry on high heat for 2-3 minutes.
tips: Use day-old cold rice for the best texture.

ingredients: lentils:1 cup, onion:1, tomato:1, garlic:3 clove, cumin:1 tsp, salt:1 tsp, water:4 cup
steps: 1. Saute onion and garlic in a pot. 2. Add lentils, chopped tomato, cumin, salt, and water. 3. Simmer 20 minutes until lentils are soft.
tips: Blend half the soup for a creamier texture.

ingredients: rice:2 cup, curd:1 cup, mustard seeds:1 tsp, curry leaves:6, green chili:1, oil:1 tbsp, salt:1 tsp
steps: 1. Mix cooked rice with curd and salt. 2. Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and chili. 3. Pour tempering over rice and mix.
tips: Cooling and easy on the stomach; great for a hot day.

ingredients: bread:2 slice, cheese:2 slice, butter:1 tbsp
steps: 1. Butter one side of each bread slice. 2. Place cheese between slices, buttered sides out. 3. Grill on a pan until golden and cheese melts.
tips: Add a thin layer of tomato or chutney for extra flavor.
